$comment: Domain-agnostic replay fixture for route tests. Globs are GENERIC risk classes (access-control, money, data-migration, infrastructure, request entrypoints) — no application- or domain-specific names. Recall tests below prove a change touching any declared risk class is forced critical; precision tests prove a docs file merely mentioning a risk word is NOT. HONESTY: authoring a surface that catches known risk families is not proof it catches the NEXT unknown incident; per-repo surfaces must be authored from that repo's own incidents and validated hold-out. Real past-bug fixtures live PRIVATELY per repo, never committed to this domain-agnostic tool.
